title: Figurative Language — Types of Figurative Language
skills: identify common types of figurative language
analyze how figurative language shapes meaning and imagery
support interpretations of figurative language with textual evidence
alignment_note: Introduces figurative language and common literary devices used to communicate ideas beyond literal meaning. Supports close reading, interpretation of simile, metaphor, personification and related techniques, author's craft analysis, and evidence-based discussion across high school English courses.
